sequential_dependency.step_a: Compute the canonical bottommost-survivor grid, retaining the bottommost nonzero cell in each active input column.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Filter the original input grid, retaining exactly the cells whose color equals the survivor-mode color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: This case makes the survivor-mode color 7 while the whole-input modal color is 8, and it includes color-7 cells above columns whose bottom survivor has another color.
